title: Say Trono na Katuaan
intro: Sakey a makapanyarin manuley, a kabkabat ed baleg a kakabatan tan makapadinayew a trono ra, so akaawat na misteryoson mensahe a nanlapud ag-amta a lapuan. Sayan ag-iilaloan a komunikasyon so mangaabet ed saray sisiaen tan autoridad da, ya mangiletneg ed sikara ed sakey a diplomatikon biahe a manubok ed inkadunong da tan diad kaunoran et mangitonton ed aralem ya espiritual a pakaliktar. Sarag mo kasin naamtaan no siopa iyan soberano tan saray ebento ya amasimbalo ed interon panarian da?
clues: Inggalang mi tan saray totook so agew, a tinumbok mi ray kagagawa da ray lalaki mi.
Sakey a manok, sakey a hoopoe, so ag-iilaloan ya mensahero ya angitarok ed siak na sulat manlapud sakey a makapanyarin lider.
Pian nasubok so kakabatan na angibaki, angibaki ak na ankablin regalo, balet ta nipawil iratan, lapud say angibaki et walaan na mas baleg a kayamanan manlapud si Allah.
Antis ak ni ingen ya akasabi ed korte na angibaki, say makapadinayew ya trono ko et mamilagron niyakar diman ed sakey a kirem na mata.
Nen sinmabi ak, tinepetan da ak no kasin kayarian ko so inawit a trono, tan inmebat ak, 'Singa sikato so mismon trono.'

Linmoob ak ed sakey a baleg a hall ya say datal to et inisip kon sakey a pool na danum, tan diad saman a bekta na takot, insukok so inkasiak a kaiba si Propeta Sulaiman ed si Allah, say Katawan na saray mundo.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Say Reyna na Sheba
Zulaikha (Asawa nen Al-Aziz)
Asiya (Asawan Faraon)
Say Ina nen Musa
Maryam (Ina nen Isa)

trial.label: Say Manunan Agawa
options: Makaawat na sulat manlapud si Propeta Sulaiman
Say pangibantak ed apoy
Manggawa na biong pian makaliktar ed delap
Say pangibiig ed Ambalangan Dayat
Say pakaakusaan na ag-inkahustisya
trial.answer: Makaawat na sulat manlapud si Propeta Sulaiman

location.label: Say Manunan Bengatla
options: Sakey a makapadinayew a trono
Sakey a balitok a kilaw a baka
Sakey ya amerikana ya dakel so kolor to
Sakey a baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg
Sakey a barkon gawad tabla tan pako

outcome.label: Say Sankasumpalan
options: Manpasakop ed saksakey a tuan Dios (Allah)
Say pagmaliw ya lusek na asin
Manggawa na atagey a tori pian nasabi so Dios
Say inakmon na baleg a sira
Say pakawalaan na baleg a kayamanan bilang dusa
outcome.answer: Manpasakop ed saksakey a tuan Dios (Allah)

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
